title: Mapping Memes to Words for Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification
reasoning: The paper evaluates models on their ability to classify memes based on their 'hatefulness' and 'harmfulness'. It specifically uses the Hateful Memes Challenge (HMC) dataset, which includes hate speech directed at religion, and the HarMeme dataset, which labels content as very harmful, partially harmful, or harmless. This involves benchmarking AI performance on moral and ethical judgments as well as its ability to identify religious discrimination.
